preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The size of arrays A and B, N, must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of operations K must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**5 <= A[i] <= 10**5 for i in range(N)) and all(-10**5 <= B[i] <= 10**5 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements of arrays A and B must be within the range of -100,000 to 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum interaction value calculated for each test case.
